comment: Version naming policy consumed by tools/gen_cann_release.py.
A new CANN version is auto-generatable only when its name matches one
of the kind patterns below (first match wins, in listed order).
Anything unmatched (e.g. historical 8.3.rc2-style names or future
schemes) aborts the generator so the release goes through the manual
release-cann-image skill instead. Extend this file, not the script,
when the community introduces a new naming style.
